_note: The tutorial dressed in the Neon City bundle (tools/tutorial-dress.ts bakes it into public/models/paid/neon/tutorial-v<version>.glb; src/game/tutorialdress.ts draws it over the course's own boxes, which it still collides with). `roles` is the bundle's material each surface wears, tiled at the scale the bundle's own pieces wear it (measured by the tool, printed when it bakes); `pieces` the bundle's pieces set about the rooms, [City Builder path, x, y, z, yaw]; `candidates` the materials tools/neongallery.html shows side by side (DRESS=swatch) to choose from. `texture` and `normal` the textures' sizes: one small file, not the city's 155 MB. Bump `version` with every bake that ships.
_roles: Chosen off the swatch sheet (DRESS=swatch, 2026-10-18): the floor the dark tiles with their blue lights, the walls the cyan-lit tech panel, a ledge you jump onto painted yellow so it reads from the door, its top a plated grey; the decks and steps dark panels with tech plates on top; the climb's wall the ribbed metal; the slick walls dark glass; a pit's floor a dark red.
_pieces: The bundle's own neon signs (its English ones only, and NEON009, robot in Korean: see docs, the pack's foreign signs are read before they go anywhere), tube lights and lanterns, on the walls 6.5 m up and over, above any wall run (a run along the lit wall is 2 to 4 m up), so nothing stands in a way through a room; the lanterns hang over the turn.
